title: [Master]-Bug 645041: Expense Agent - Rename Enable approval workflow caption and tooltip
summary: The Expense Agent Setup page renamed the approval workflow toggle to clarify it switches to traditional approval instead of the Expense Agent experience, and adjusted field prominence.
key_points: Caption changed from 'Enable approval workflow' to 'Use traditional approval workflow'
Tooltip clarifies the toggle switches expense reports away from Expense Agent to traditional approval
Approval workflow toggle and Default Approver field set to Additional importance for less prominence
Improves UI clarity about the control's purpose relative to Expense Agent functionality
